jobs.description:
We are looking for a versatile CE driver & warehouse worker (M/F/X) to join the team of a well-known employer in Zaventem. In addition to driving the lorry between the two warehouses (distance of approximately 12 kilometres), you will also work as a warehouse worker and be deployed in a multifunctional role.
 

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

 

• You are stress-resistant, accurate and able to stay focused. 

• You are a team player. 

• You are flexible and motivated. 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus! 

• You can easily travel to work. 

• You have the ability to work in a rotating two-shift system.

Work hands-on with advanced process tools that enable state-of-the-art solutions for imec's R&D programs.
 

 
 

Imec is the world-leading research and innovation hub in nanoelectronics and digital technologies. The combination of our widely acclaimed leadership in microchip technology and profound software and ICT expertise is what makes us unique. To strengthen this position, we are looking for a Hardware Engineer to join our LAB Hardware team (LABHW) in Leuven.
 

The LABHW team is part of imec’s Lab Operations & Coordination Department and plays a key role in maintaining and supporting the hardware infrastructure used in our advanced research labs. The team delivers technical support to the R&D organization by ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of lab equipment. We contribute directly to the success of many research programs at imec.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

With your hardware and process colleagues, you ensure that tools are running smoothly and efficiently. You support imec’s research programs as a link between hardware capabilities and process requirements. You work in a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment in close collaboration with researchers, students, process and hardware engineers, industry assignees, and device and process experts.
 
 

• As a Hardware Engineer, you take on a key role in developing next-generation semiconductor technologies. You work closely with application and R&D teams to deliver state-of-the-art solutions that support imec’s research programs. 

• During an intensive training period, you will be coached by our team. They will introduce you to the Lab activities and provide the knowledge and hands-on experience you need to succeed in your role. 

• You are responsible for all phases of the equipment lifecycle, including purchasing new equipment, hook-up, maintenance, user support, quality control, and decommissioning. The tools you will work on include dry and wet etching, photolithography, characterization (ellipsometry, microscopy, profilometry), thin-film deposition, sputtering, and evaporation. 

• You document tool information and status and keep inventory information for consumables and spare parts up to date. 

• You contribute to the development of new prototype tools, prepare plans for replacing existing equipment, and follow up on new tool installations. 

• Part of your activities will involve supporting the process team in the development of specific process steps. 

• You will work in a day-shift schedule. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a degree in Engineering (Mechanical or Electrical/Electronics Engineering) or have at least 5 years of experience in the electronics or semiconductor industry. 

• You can work without supervision in a lab environment and combine strong hands-on skills with a structured way of working, attention to detail, and high quality standards. 

• You are a problem solver who focuses on solutions rather than obstacles. Thanks to your sense of urgency, you act proactively and are comfortable taking initiative when needed. 

• As timing is critical in our business, we are looking for someone with strong problem-solving and organizational skills who can evaluate and respond effectively to requests and issues in a timely manner. You enjoy a high degree of autonomy, are motivated by continuous learning and development, and can quickly acquire new knowledge and skills. 

• You are a strong communicator who listens actively, builds constructive relationships, and takes a customer-focused approach. You communicate clearly and effectively. 

• You are a collaborative team player who shares technical expertise, supports colleagues when needed, and contributes to common goals. 

• You are comfortable using the MS Office suite and working with data. 

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is required.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 
strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 
Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

jobs.occupation: AI Security Engineer – LLM & GenAI Security
jobs.description:
